forward-speed: Forward speed along the rail when not boosting or braking (Q/E still scale from this). Bullet speed scales with this setting; boost still adds ship speed only, so you can outrun your shots along the rail.
toggle-mouse: Enable mouse aiming relative to screen center.
toggle-crosshair-mouse: Crosshair: Ship = crosshairs follow ship aim. Crosshair: Mouse = crosshairs follow exact cursor (Mouse Aim must be On).
toggle-touch: Cycle touch controls: Off, Stick, Drag.
toggle-instructions: Show or hide HUD control tips.
toggle-rail: Show the scrolling rail path (ground strips). Future: curves, hills, live updates. Hides only the mesh—flight bounds stay the same.
toggle-world-video: Full-frame POV backdrop (cover crop) parented to the camera — see public/video/pov-sample.mp4. Off = classic sky color only.
toggle-world-immersion: Enables the inner bowl on the POV screen. With Dome + zoom up, the backdrop also moves closer and scales past the edges of the view for a more wraparound feel.
world-dome-depth: With Inner dome on: stronger bowl, moves the POV screen closer (zoom), and scales past the view so edges wrap more. Slider 0–500 (500 = full zoom + bowl). 0 = flat at normal distance.
toggle-auto-lock: Hold R to lock and fire an instant laser at the closest target.
toggle-auto-fire: Auto-fire a single bolt when crosshair locks.
